what: CubeSmart owns and manages self-storage facilities across the United States, concentrated in large coastal cities, and also manages stores owned by other people for a fee.
customers: Households between homes or short of space, and small businesses storing stock and equipment.
moat: Storage is chosen by location: customers pick the facility nearest them, so owning the sites in dense cities where new building is hard is the whole advantage.
risks: Storage demand follows house moves, which are depressed by high mortgage rates
Revenue has been flat at $1.1B for three years
The analyst average target is roughly where the shares trade
opportunities: A 29.7% net margin and $609M of free cash flow on $1.1B of revenue
Almost no debt at $50M, unusual for a property company
New storage construction has fallen sharply, which should let rents recover when moving activity returns
watch: Same-store revenue growth and move-in rents, which lead it.
